title: A part sale's single Sales Representative field still saves and logs
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced part sale for this test for that customer, with its Sales Representative field reading "Unassigned".
  • Open the part sale in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the part sale's Sales Representative field.
  2. Click the field.
  3. Click sales rep A in the dropdown.
  4. Reload the page.
  5. Open the part sale's menu.
  6. Open the log from the menu and read the newest entry.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • There is one representative field, labelled "Sales representative" with a small "r".
  • There is no + button beside it.

Step 2:

  • The dropdown opens.

Step 3:

  • The field reads sales rep A.
  • Its label still reads "Sales representative".
  • There is still no + and no remove x.

Step 4:

  • The field still reads sales rep A.
  • The pick was saved.

Step 5:

  • The part sale's menu opens.

Step 6:

  • The log has an entry for the change of the representative to sales rep A, worded as a part sale's log entry was worded before this release.

The part sale's Sales Representative field and its log entry come from Part Sales Update v1 (SV-10266). If that is not on the build being tested, mark this case Blocked and say so.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative), story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives), story SV-11271 (Story 7, Record representative changes in the work order log)

  • S2-N2: “A part sale's card has no + button. A part sale keeps one Sales Representative field, exactly as Part Sales Update v1 builds it: its label stays "Sales representative" and its look and behavior do not change.”
  • S4-R32: “Picking a person, or "Unassigned", on a work order or part sale changes only that work order or part sale, never its customer.”
  • Story 7 context note: “* Context note: Part Sales Update v1 adds the log entry for a single representative, on part sales and work orders. This story makes the work order entry read both sides. It ships after that release.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 7: “7. (b) Nothing changes: keep the label and the look exactly as Part Sales Update v1 built them.”
